fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled, with appmix transactions.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, file blocking, and logging enabled, utilizing appmix transactions.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions, and logging enabled.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Max concurrent sessions are measured utilizing HTTP transactions.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override, utilizing 1 byte HTTP transactions.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

vsys_base.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: The base system includes 25 virtual systems at no cost, and up to 200 additional licenses may be purchased. The maximum number of virtual systems supported is 225.
Results in this column were derived from an optimum combination of PA-7000-DPC-A and PA-7000-100G-NPC-A cards populated in all available slots.

vsys_max.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
